_source: rsprox recording 3886 (rev 235): Set Destination and Teleport to Destination at the level 13 obelisk. OSRS Wiki: Wilderness_Obelisk. The obelisks' south-west corner stones and ids come from the cache map; `corner` is the south-west stone, the others are 4 tiles east, north and north-east, and the pad is the 3x3 between them.

menu._recorded: Menu 187 through script 217 with these args; the pause button's sub is the obelisk, and the varbit takes sub + 1.
menu.title: Select Obelisk destination

_timeline: Recorded, in ticks after the click: the stones glow and synth 204 plays four times (delay 10) at once; the smokepuff and area sound at 7; the stones back at 10; the portal on the pad's nine tiles at 11; the teleport at 13.

messages._recorded: chosen: recorded (a set destination). random: the Wiki's arrival line.

messages.random: Ancient magic teleports you somewhere in the Wilderness!
